tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Ménage Parfait home-cleaning offer in Paris/Île-de-France: price grid (TTC and HT), extras with ids, frequency discounts, area, payment, and when the 50% tax credit may apply.

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Check whether a French postcode is in the service area.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact price (same calculation as menageparfait.fr): TTC (show this to the customer), HT, VAT, and the cost after the 50% tax credit if the customer is eligible.

tools.name: get_time_slots
tools.description: Dates and 2-hour arrival windows that can be requested (up to 90 days ahead). Windows start between 10:00 and 16:00; no evening bookings.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a home-cleaning booking for the price, date and arrival window the customer agreed to, and returns a secure Stripe payment_url. The booking is confirmed when the customer opens payment_url and saves a card (charged after the cleaning). The link is also emailed to the customer. Requires custo

tools.name: get_post_construction_estimate
tools.description: Price range for a post-construction cleaning (nettoyage fin de travaux / fin de chantier) in Paris/Île-de-France, same calculation as the estimator on menageparfait.fr: HT and TTC (VAT 20%).

tools.name: request_office_quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to Ménage Parfait for office cleaning or post-construction cleaning (reply within 1 business day).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_post_construction_estimate · Public sink: get_post_construction_estimate, request_office_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_post_construction_estimate · Public sink: get_post_construction_estimate, request_office_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Ménage Parfait home-cleaning offer in Paris/Île-de-France: price grid (HT), extras with ids, frequency discounts, area, payment and 50% tax-credit rules." → after: "Ménage Parfait home-cleaning offer in Paris/Île-de-France: price grid (TTC and HT), extras with ids, frequency discounts, area, payment, and when the 50% tax credit may apply."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
